hooks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.sdd/scripts/check-design-rules.ps1" -Changed > /dev/null 2>&1; hook_exit=$?; if [ "$hook_exit" -eq 0 ]; then printf '%s' '{"continue":true}'; fi; exit "$hook_exit"
hooks.commandWindows: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& (Join-Path ((git rev-parse --show-toplevel).Trim()) '.sdd/scripts/check-design-rules.ps1') -Changed *> $null; $hookExit = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($hookExit -eq 0) { [Console]::Out.Write((@{ continue = $true } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)) }; exit $hookExit"
hooks.statusMessage: Checking changed C# and Razor files...
